name: Karma Atranger
original_name: カーマ・アトランジャー
source:
Karma Atranger is a girl protected by the Revolutionary Group, Ice Flame, being the leader of the kids gang in the orphanage ran by Kimchi Drive. Being one of the eldest among the children, she tried to act like an older sister to the other kids. 

She developed a crush for Rance during the events of Rance VI, and tried to gain his attention. However, Rance found her too young, and treated her as a child despite her attempts at seducing him. After the Collapse of Zeth, she leaves the country on her own and travels around the world, returning in Rance Quest as a playable character of the ranger class.

[From [url=https://alicesoft.miraheze.org/wiki/Karma_Atlanger]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
